reference_families.people_activity: walking, sitting, meeting and looking toward the coast
reference_families.edge_background: El Beso, curved mosaic walls, heart gardens and cliff horizon
reference_families.proves: The official inventory identifies a designed ensemble rather than an isolated sculpture, allowing the curved wall and rotunda to channel bodies and sightlines.
reference_families.cannot_prove: A non-staged decisive gesture, current crowd density or least saturated viewpoint.

reference_families.people_activity: couples, families and friends gathering around a calendar event
reference_families.edge_background: restored sculpture, planted hearts, palms and maintained furniture

reference_families.edge_background: excavated cliff edge, void-facing rooms and Pacific coast

reference_families.cannot_prove: Exact present sightline, crowd occlusion or sunset quality.

reference_families.people_activity: meeting, sitting, watching performances and crossing

reference_families.cannot_prove: Exact performance schedule, crowd hierarchy or a clean background.
